item.title: Optimize Your Resume for ATS and Humans 🤖 • Use: “I increased sales by 20% in Q1.” • Include keywords from the job description. • Use clear, professional formatting. • Avoid images and complex graphics. • Tailor your resume for each application. How can you ensure your resume speaks to both machines and people? #resume #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
